Mamata Banerjee alleges BJP wished for her death by heart attack

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has stated that BJP members wished for her to die of a heart attack. She vowed to remain alive until the end of the BJP's tenure. The remarks were made in response to alleged comments from BJP workers.
